reason: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:73-80, updating an existing credential only writes `data: { key: keys }` and never resets `invalid: false` (nor do the token-refresh updates such as packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:98-101 or packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:96-99). Once a credential is marked `invalid: true` (e.g., packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:112-117), it stays invalid even after new keys are synced via the webhook, causing packages/core/getCalendarsEvents.ts:17 to keep skipping it and the UI to keep flagging it as invalid.
